label: Everything is speeding up, with no time frame given
description: A standing statement that events are being sped up and that Jesus is coming, with an explicit refusal to name a time frame. Kept apart from the dated acceleration claims so that an unfalsifiable general statement is never scored as if it carried their dates.

label: Every road paves toward a two-state solution
description: His reading that every development points toward a two-state solution, given without a date and cited alongside a Kim Clement word of 1 November 2014. Distinct from the dated two-state claims, which name a year.

label: Pray about October 2024, a great storm is coming
description: A call in August 2024 to pray about October, with more voices warning by the Spirit and a great storm said to be coming. Held separate from the October 2023 word and from the 3 October 2024 tipping point, neither of which he names here.
